# asciinema-player 3.17.0 (vendored)

Unmodified `dist/bundle/asciinema-player.min.js` and `asciinema-player.css`
from the npm package `asciinema-player@3.17.0`
(<https://github.com/asciinema/asciinema-player>), Apache License 2.0 (see
`LICENSE`). Vendored so the docs site plays tape recordings
(`docs/recordings.md`) without a third-party CDN. To upgrade, run
`npm pack asciinema-player@<version>` and copy the same two files into a new
versioned directory.
